recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON; Tail is below the block threshold, with risk concentrated around geopolitical headline transmission and Monday U.S. data/opening price discovery.
headline: Orderly Sunday reopening keeps Tail low despite severe geopolitical headline risk
body: Sunday reopening evidence remains two-sided: late-Sunday reporting described U.S. index futures as only fractionally higher, while fresh delayed Finviz context showed NQ +0.26%, ES +0.09%, VX +0.58% and WTI -0.07%. This does not establish persistent NQ extension. Hormuz disruption and Russia-Ukraine escalation keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 hourly assessments, Tail stayed in the low band at 17-19%. Stress rose from 84% to 90% as weekend geopolitical risk accumulated; the Sunday reopening briefly shifted mode to event/whipsaw before returning to mixed as early futures remained orderly.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail is expected to stay below block thresholds overnight, with a narrow WATCH window around the 12:30 UTC Empire State release, the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open and the 14:00 UTC NAHB release. Stress remains elevated by Hormuz and broader geopolitical risk.

forecast.analysis: At the assessment cutoff, Sunday futures remained only modestly positive; fresh delayed Finviz context showed NQ +0.26%, ES +0.09%, VX +0.58% and WTI -0.07%. No independent bar-level evidence showed persistent one-way NQ extension.

forecast.analysis: As Asia develops, conflicting cross-asset signals keep the baseline mixed. Persistent extension across multiple hourly bars would be required to move Tail into WATCH.
Asian mid-session risk remains headline-sensitive. Geopolitical news can keep Stress extreme, but Tail rises materially only if NQ converts headlines into sustained directional efficiency.
Late Asia is a transition hour. Continued two-sided price discovery would support low Tail; a clean break followed by failed retracements would raise conditional Tail.
Europe approaches. Broader liquidity should clarify whether the Sunday reopening move is being absorbed or extended; Tail stays low absent confirmed one-way structure.
The European open can amplify weekend headlines. Conditional risk rises only if NQ, rates, oil and volatility align; otherwise mixed conditions remain the base case.
European morning should provide a better cross-asset read. Stable rates and oil with two-sided NQ would keep Tail low despite extreme headline Stress.
Mid-European trade has no scheduled U.S. catalyst. Tail remains low unless directional breadth and NQ structure become jointly persistent.
As U.S. premarket liquidity builds, sensitivity to macro expectations rises. Conditional Tail edges up only if premarket extension is reinforced by rates, volatility and technology leadership.
The hour before Empire State is mainly a positioning window. Stress remains high, while Tail stays below WATCH unless price action becomes unusually one-way before the release.

Empire State Manufacturing at 12:30 UTC is a medium-impact checkpoint. Tail moves to WATCH conditionally because the release can combine with premarket positioning, but the result and reaction are unknown.
The 13:30 UTC cash open is the main price-discovery checkpoint. Tail peaks in WATCH conditionally; repeated extension after shallow or failed pullbacks would be the key confirmation.
NAHB at 14:00 UTC overlaps the first cash hour. Conditional Tail stays in WATCH while the opening impulse is tested for retracement versus continued directional efficiency.
drivers: NAHB Housing Market Index at 14:00 UTC

forecast.analysis: By the second cash hour, orderly retracements would lower Tail quickly. Persistent opening-direction extension across semiconductors, megacaps and breadth would keep risk elevated.
Midday liquidity usually reduces event intensity. Tail returns to low unless the morning move remains pinned near an extreme with broad cross-asset confirmation.
Early afternoon has no major scheduled macro catalyst. The baseline is mixed; delayed geopolitical headline transmission remains the main source of renewed Stress.
Afternoon structure becomes more informative than scheduled events. Tail stays low if NQ continues to rotate; a fresh second leg after a failed retracement would be the main risk.
Late afternoon tests whether the session trend is durable. Conditional Tail remains low unless breadth, semiconductors and megacaps align with renewed index extension.
The cash close at 20:00 UTC can create brief flow-driven volatility. Tail stays low unless the index is already holding near an extreme with little retracement.
CME equity-index futures enter the 21:00-22:00 UTC maintenance halt. With no new NQ price path during the break, Tail is held low while headline Stress remains elevated.
drivers: No live NQ path during halt

forecast.analysis: Globex reopens after maintenance at 22:00 UTC. Conditional risk rises slightly if a new gap appears, but Tail stays low unless extension persists after reopening.
The first full post-maintenance hour tests whether any reopening move is absorbed. Two-sided trade keeps Tail low; repeated extension would be the main conditional risk.
